plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖续批 · FR-8002 · 找到本身也为单位的模 30030 覆盖表
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage II · FR-8002 · Cover modulus 30030 with base candidates that are units

brief.zh: 逐项删除已覆盖的偶类。旧表含 3、5、7、11，这些素数的本类无法容纳三个素数提升。本表各基类均可继续提升。
brief.en: Remove the covered even classes in order. The previous table included 3,5,7,11, whose classes cannot contain three prime lifts. Each new base class can be lifted.
